{{recipe}}

This is a simple recipe for '''baked sweet potatoes'''.

==Ingredients==
*4 large "yam style" [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]], unpeeled

==Procedure==
#Scrub the sweet potatoes very well.
#Place into large glass [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. Cover loosely with [[Cookbook:Aluminium foil|aluminum foil]]. 
#Place into preheated 400°F (205°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. 
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 90 minutes or until very soft.
